name: I'll Breakup With Him, It'll Pain
source:
At what point do you end it?  Not all relationships are meant to be.  Relationships aren’t always about getting together.  There are stories about separating: suddenly, lovingly, stupidly, angrily, sadly, traitorously, disgustingly, happily and... painfully. 

Dwain and Tanner have been together for a long time but the Main Character, Dwain, realizes he doesn’t truly love Tanner. He’s been living a lie but you decide when to let the truth out and end the pain. 

How long do you want to persevere? Will you end it now or see how far it can go? 

[From [url=https://wagleunagi.itch.io/ill-breakup-with-him-itll-pain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你会在什么时候结束这段关系？并非所有感情都注定能走到最后。感情故事也并非总是在讲相聚，还有关于分离的故事。有的分离猝不及防，有的仍怀爱意，有的愚蠢，有的愤怒，有的悲伤，有的伴随背叛，有的令人厌恶，有的让人释然，还有的……痛彻心扉。

德韦恩和坦纳在一起已经很久了，但身为主人公的德韦恩意识到，自己并不真正爱坦纳。他一直活在谎言里，而何时说出真相、结束这份痛苦，将由你决定。

你还想坚持多久？是现在就结束，还是继续下去，看看这段关系究竟能走多远？

[摘自[url=https://wagleunagi.itch.io/ill-breakup-with-him-itll-pain]itch.io[/url]]
